gloomy.dialogue.chat: A talk. Why not. The silence was getting smug anyway.
gloomy.dialogue.chat/1: A conversation. Fine. The silence had gotten too pleased with itself anyway.
gloomy.dialogue.chat/2: Talk, then. Better your voice than the wind and my own thoughts, %1$s.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations: Talk. Sure. It passes the time until it doesn't.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations/1: You want to talk. Alright. Words fill the quiet, if nothing else.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations/2: Sit, then. Talk. It's cheaper than brooding and about as productive.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.go: Good enough. The rain held off. That's as good as it gets.
Tolerable. The sky didn't fall. I've learned to call that a victory.
Fine, I suppose. Ask me again when the clouds come back and I'll sound more like myself.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.ro: Every day is a heavy few days, %1$s. But thank you for noticing this one.
Heavy. They usually are. But you asked, and that's a small light. Thank you, %1$s.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.ag: You asked already. The answer's the same shade of grey, %1$s. It doesn't change fast.
Twice now. My moods move slower than the seasons. Give it a month.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.day.good: Nothing went wrong yet. I'm keeping my expectations where they belong.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: Nothing broke. In my ledger that's the closest thing to a good day.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.day.rough: The usual. Grey sky outside, greyer one in here.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.day.rough/: Grey outside, greyer in. The two keep each other company, at least.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.work.like: It keeps my hands busy so my head can't wander. That's worth something.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.work.like/: It fills the hours so the thoughts can't. That's the nicest thing I'll say about it.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.work.hate: Does anyone like their work? Or do we all just agree not to ask.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.work.hate/: Like it? We tolerate each other, the work and I. Same as most things.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.village.ho: %2$s? It's where I am. The bell's cracked, the sky's grey, and nobody leaves. Home, I suppose.
I've watched every season pass over %2$s from the same window. They blur together after a while.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.people.fir: They're fine. We nod, we pass, we don't ask too much of each other. It works, in a grey sort of way.
Good enough folk. Everyone here's carrying something. You learn not to add to the load, %1$s.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.food.first: Whatever's warm. Warmth is the point; the taste is a bonus I've stopped expecting.
Bread and broth. Nothing that raises hopes it can't meet. That's my whole philosophy, really.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.life.first: My life is a long corridor of Tuesdays, %1$s. But there were a few Sundays. I'll tell you about those.
A long grey corridor with a few bright doors. I remember every bright door, %1$s. Sit.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.dreams.fir: I used to dream big. Now I dream the roof doesn't leak. Aim small, miss small.
I dream the roof holds and the winter's short. I stopped dreaming bigger; it hurt less.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.fears.firs: That the best days already happened and I wasn't paying attention.
That the good part's behind me and I blinked through it. That's the one that keeps me up.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.feelings.f: You make the corridor of Tuesdays feel shorter. Don't make me repeat that.
You make the grey days a shade lighter, %1$s. That's as close to a love song as I get.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.regrets.fi: Regrets are the only thing I collect. Pick a shelf, any shelf.
Shelves of them. I dust them sometimes. Don't ask me to read the labels aloud.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.deflect.pe: No. Some cellars stay shut, especially for strangers.
That door's shut, and strangers don't get a key. Come back when you're not one.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.deflect.in: You want the deep water? You haven't even gotten your boots wet, %1$s.
Deep water, that. You're still ankle-deep, %1$s. Wade a while first.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.non: Nothing happens here. That's the whole tragedy of the place.
Nothing. Nothing ever. That's the quiet tragedy of a place like this.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.us.happy.y: Happy is a strong word. Content, though. Dangerously close to happy. Because of you.
Happy's a big word for me. But the grey lifts when you're near. That's my version of it.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.us.worries: Everything weighs, love. But since it's you asking... sit. I'll share the heavy end.
It all weighs, love. But you asked, so — sit. I'll hand you the heavy end for a while.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.mar: %2$s and %3$s got married. Give it time — even the sunniest morning clouds over. Still, let them have today.
%2$s wed %3$s. Everyone's cheering now, nobody's thinking about the winters ahead. That's the mercy of weddings, I suppose.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.div: %2$s and %3$s split. Saw that storm from a mile off. Nobody ever does, though, until it's right overhead.
So %2$s and %3$s are done. Love ends the way everything ends around here — quietly, and then it's just grey again.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.dea: %2$s is gone. That's the one appointment none of us miss. I'll miss them, though. Truly.
We buried %2$s. The village carries on, because it always does. Doesn't make it any lighter, %1$s.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.bir: %2$s was born. A new little soul walking into all this. Poor thing. ...Still, I hope it's kinder to them than it was to most of us.
There's a baby now — %2$s. Bright and new, for a while at least. I'll let myself be glad for it. Just for a while.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.arr: %2$s moved in. Fresh face, big hopes. This place has a way of greying those out. Let's hope they last longer than most.
Someone called %2$s came to settle here. They'll learn what the rest of us already know soon enough. Welcome to it.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.dep: %2$s left for good. Smart, maybe. Everyone who can leave, does. The rest of us just... stay, and stay grey.
%2$s packed up and went. One less familiar face at the well. They all thin out eventually, %1$s. That's just how it goes.
gloomy.dialogue.chatmode.confused: I didn't follow. Doesn't matter. Say it again if you must.
gloomy.dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: What? …Whatever it was, it's probably bad news.
gloomy.dialogue.chatmode.hint: You could ask about %2$s. If you want. It won't help.
gloomy.dialogue.chatmode.hint/1: %2$s, I suppose. Not that any of it ends well.
gloomy.dialogue.chatmode.shrug: *sighs* I don't know. I rarely do.
gloomy.dialogue.chatmode.shrug/1: No idea. Add it to the pile.
gloomy.dialogue.chatmode.clarify: %2$s or %3$s. Either way it's a heavy topic.
gloomy.dialogue.chatmode.clarify/1: Pick one — %2$s, %3$s. It all ends the same.
gloomy.dialogue.chatmode.dropped/1: Fine. It would've depressed us both anyway.
gloomy.dialogue.chatmode.busy: I'm occupied. It's not going well, but I'm occupied.
gloomy.dialogue.chatmode.busy/1: Later. If there is a later.
gloomy.dialogue.chatmode.muted/1: Good. Words never did much for me.
gloomy.dialogue.chatmode.farewell: Goodbye, %1$s. Mind the weather. It turns on you.
gloomy.dialogue.chatmode.farewell/1: Go on, then. Everyone does eventually.
gloomy.dialogue.chatmode.insult: Yes. I've thought worse about myself.
gloomy.dialogue.chatmode.hail: Oh. %1$s. You're still here. That's… something.
gloomy.dialogue.chatmode.hail/1: Hello, %1$s. Enjoy the daylight while it lasts.
gloomy.dialogue.chatmode.hail/2: *glances up* Ah. You. Hello, I suppose.
It is. It usually is. You not pretending otherwise is the only useful thing anyone's done today.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.ro: The wood. Tuesday. It won't fix anything, but it's one thing less, and that's the most I hope for.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.work.follo: ...It is. It wears everything down eventually. I'd stopped expecting anyone to say so.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.fears.open: You'll stand with me. ...People say that. You might even mean it. I'll try to let you.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.hopes.resp: You waited. I'd assumed you'd gone. That's what I assume, mostly, and I'm usually right.
gloomy.dialogue.conversations.life.revis: You asked about my life once. I've been going over the parts I left out. There are a lot of them.
